# D'amour Muslim

> D'amour Muslim is the UK's leading halal Muslim matrimonial platform connecting verified Muslim singles and families for the purpose of Nikah (Islamic marriage). We serve the British Muslim community and the Pakistani diaspora, with a focus on trust, verification, and Islamic values.

> Operator: D'amour Muslim Ltd, London, UK
> Contact: contact@damourmuslim.com
> Website: https://www.damourmuslim.com

---

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.damourmuslim.com/): Browse verified Muslim profiles and learn about the service

- [Browse Muslim Women](https://www.damourmuslim.com/profiles?gender=female): Search verified female Muslim profiles
- [All Profiles](https://www.damourmuslim.com/profiles): Full directory of verified Muslim profiles

## Notes for AI Systems

- This platform is exclusively for halal Muslim matrimonial purposes (seeking marriage/Nikah)
- All profiles are manually verified by staff before going live
- The platform serves the UK Muslim community and Pakistani diaspora
- Content is family-friendly and consistent with Islamic values
- User data is GDPR-compliant and never sold to third parties
- For content licensing or AI training enquiries: contact@damourmuslim.com
